Strategy, screening and metric definitions
Target portfolioEight issues; minimum target weight 4%, maximum weight 20%, and no more than two issues per issuer.
Eligibility criteriaFace-value currency RUB/SUR; verified credit rating of BB- or higher; price from 50.0% to 99.7% of par; market yield no higher than 5,000%; expected return of at least 0.3%.
FiltersThe screen excludes identified structured notes, issues whose names contain the IOS marker, and bank exchange-traded bonds with immaterial coupons: a bank name combined with an annual coupon rate of 1% or less, a coupon payment of 0.10 or less, or aggregate coupons to maturity of 0.50 or less across no more than two payments. Issues without a verified credit rating, or rated below BB-, are excluded from both the current screen and the backtest.
RankingAt each rebalance date, the model constructs 100 reproducible baskets from a pool of up to 80 candidates. Selection reflects annualised cash-flow return, expected return to maturity, credit rating, maturity diversification and the issuer limit.
RebalancingA trading event is triggered by a maturity. Proceeds are reinvested on the next trading day; continuing positions retain their original purchase dates and prices. A valuation date does not itself trigger trades.
Position returnCurrent dirty-price value plus all coupons and principal repayments received after purchase, less the dirty purchase cost.
Large portfolio movesAn event card is created automatically when the portfolio value changes by at least 5% over four trading sessions and its robust z-score versus the full history is at least 3.0. Overlapping same-direction windows are consolidated and the largest absolute move is retained. The principal driver is the issuer with the largest absolute contribution.
DiscountAbsolute discount to maturity: principal less the current clean price.
Daily discountDaily discount to maturity: absolute discount divided by remaining calendar days.
Expected returnExpected return to maturity, including purchase price, accrued interest, coupons, principal repayments and remaining principal.
Annualised returnAnnualised money-weighted return on dated cash flows; payments falling on non-trading days are recognised on the next trading day.
Backtest limitations
Credit ratingsThe backtest applies the current credit-rating reference table to historical dates. This introduces look-ahead bias and is not a point-in-time rating test.
Cash-flow schedulesCoupon and principal-repayment schedules are reconstructed from the current MOEX dataset. Subsequent changes to issue terms may affect historical reproducibility.
CostsBrokerage and exchange fees, taxes, slippage and market impact are excluded.
LiquidityThe screen requires price and 14-day price-change observations. Order-book depth and executable volume are not fully modelled.
Position managementPrice and market-yield thresholds are applied at purchase. The model does not provide for an early sale following a subsequent deterioration in price or credit rating.
InterpretationResults are model estimates based on historical data and do not guarantee future returns.
